notes.title: Characterize one HW-870 sensor
notes.body: Photo identification confirms four-pin HW-870 reflective IR modules, not time-of-flight devices. Use the separate sensor-only bench page to observe raw DO and AO before choosing threshold or polarity.

notes.title: Confirm the remaining electrical details
notes.body: UNO R4 WiFi, HW-870 modules and strip/adapter label ratings are identified. Strip input arrow, connector polarity and the final LED power arrangement still need verification.

notes.title: Capture a bench-test record
notes.body: Record the board, library version, wiring, expected result and observed result. Keep source inspection separate from a physical test pass.

notes.title: Evaluate non-blocking animation
notes.body: The current animations use delay(25), so loop() does not poll sensors while they play. A non-blocking design could be evaluated later; the original sketch is preserved.
